status: analysis policy lock; not a model; no version assigned
inputsAllowedAtDecisionTime: strict walk-forward OOS horse probabilities generated from dates strictly before current race date
JRA official historical odds for the race and bet type
pre-race race/runner fields including repaired official surface, distance and class
online statistics calculated only from dates strictly before current race date

ticketProbabilityExperts.combinationProbability: Plackett-Luce/Harville-style combination probability from the selected horse probability source; this is a probability model only and never a synthetic odds replacement
ticketScoreFamilies: Bayesian-shrunk online realized return for the same expert using prior dates only
ticketProbabilityExperts.expertChoice: chosen independently by course and bet type from performance on dates strictly before current race date

raceFeatureFamilies: top-1/top-3/top-5 ticket EV score summaries for every required bet type
count and mass of official-odds tickets with model edge above market
field size, race number, surface, distance bucket and race class
cross-bet consistency between win/wide/quinella/exacta/trio/trifecta where the course permits them
raceSelection.selector: expanding-window LightGBM regression of realized course return trained only on dates strictly before the current race date
raceSelection.selectorRetrain: fixed expanding date blocks; no same-date learning
raceSelection.coldStartRule: rank races by the average of the top-three fixed ticket EV scores across the course required bet types
raceSelection.selectionCount: exactly 5 races per raceDate x venue; never fewer

budgetAllocation.allocationRule: after placing the required 100 yen minimum in every required bet type, allocate remaining 100-yen units to the currently highest utility ticket across required bet types; utility is fixed ticket score multiplied by Bayesian-shrunk prior-date bet-type/expert return; repeatedly enforce the 10% per-ticket course-budget cap and use the next ranked ticket when capped

officialOdds.missingOdds: remain missing; never estimate or backfill

settlement.source: actual JRA payout rows from fixed archive
